title: 78′ Flybridge Motor Yacht Overview and Key Traits
description: Pristine 78ft 2021 motor yacht in Miami, only US example, twin MAN V12s and Sleipner fin stabilization.
html:
This 78-foot flybridge motor yacht, built in 2021 and located in Miami, presents a striking combination of contemporary lines and serious seagoing systems; with a 5.67 ft draft and four cabins, she’s configured for both entertaining and extended cruising. The yacht is presented in pristine condition and features twin MAN V12 1900 diesel engines with low hours, providing strong propulsion and reliability for passage-making; a specific top speed is not listed. Notable mechanical and navigation equipment includes twin Raymarine Axiom XL16 displays at both lower and upper helms and a Raymarine 12kW Magnum HD open-array radar, and she is not for sale to US residents while in US waters.

Elegant Interior Layout: Four Cabins and Walnut Finish

The interior is finished in satin walnut, creating a warm, refined atmosphere throughout the accommodation deck where four cabins provide flexible sleeping arrangements for owners and guests. Underfloor heating has been installed in the master plus guest port and starboard cabins for comfortable cooler-climate use, and upgraded upper and lower accommodation lighting enhances ambiance and practicality. Careful joinery and layout considerations maximize natural light and circulation, making the saloon and cabin spaces feel both welcoming and purposeful for extended stays aboard.

Twin Man V12 Power, Stabilization and Systems Upgrades

Power and seakeeping are central to this yacht’s appeal: the twin MAN V12 1900 diesels are complemented by a Sleipner Vector Fin stabilization system to reduce roll at anchor and underway, while hydraulic bow and stern thrusters greatly simplify docking and close-quarters maneuvering. Electrical independence is supported by two Onan 27 kW generators, and a freshwater maker adds autonomy for longer trips. Navigation and control are enhanced by the dual Axiom XL16 multifunction displays on both helms, giving the captain full situational awareness whether piloting from the lower station or the flybridge.

Exterior Design: Metallic Hull, Teak Decks and Sunroof

Visually the yacht stands out with a metallic charcoal-grey hull contrasted by a white superstructure, and exterior spaces are finished with teak-laid side decks and a teak foredeck walkthrough for both aesthetic appeal and practical footing. The GRP flybridge hardtop incorporates an electric opening sunroof, creating an airy, sheltered social space that can be adjusted for sun or shade, while large forward and aft decks provide versatile areas for lounging, dining or fishing. The combination of sculpted profiles and practical deck layouts supports both relaxed cruising and more active days on the water.

Comfort Systems: Air Conditioning, Heating and Power

Climate control and onboard services are engineered for year-round comfort: reverse-cycle air-conditioning and heating handle a wide range of temperatures, supplemented by underfloor heating in primary cabins for additional comfort in cooler conditions. Electrical capacity from the twin Onan generators ensures hotel systems, galley appliances and entertainment equipment run reliably, and the freshwater maker increases independence from marinas. Interior and exterior lighting upgrades further improve evening ambience and safety when operating or entertaining after dusk.

Summary and Next Steps: Key Features and Viewing Info

This 78-foot, 2021 flybridge motor yacht combines contemporary styling with robust systems—twin MAN V12 engines, vector fin stabilization, twin 27 kW generators, comprehensive Raymarine electronics, teak decks and a GRP flybridge hardtop with electric sunroof—making her well suited to owners seeking a capable, comfortable platform for coastal cruising or island-hopping from her Miami base. Interested buyers should note the regulatory restriction on sales to US residents while in US waters; viewings can be arranged locally to inspect the mechanicals, accommodation fit-out and onboard systems firsthand.

For more information on this yacht including additional pictures and brochures, or to schedule a tour, please contact us below. While efforts have been made to ensure accuracy, readers are encouraged to verify details independently.
